newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp gets Chinese approval for $1.8 billion plant.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp gets Chinese approval for $1.8 billion plant.

text.p: Asia Pulp & Paper Co. Ltd., the global pulp and paper company, said Wednesday it received approval from the Chinese State Planning Commission to build a paper and packaging joint venture plant in China at a cost of $1.5 billion to $1.8 billion.
Asia Pulp said the facility would have two paper machines with combined annual capacity of 500,000 to 700,000 metric tons and a boxboard or linerboard machine with annual capacity of 450,000 tons.
The estimated total cost included the purchase of machinery, plant construction costs and costs of establishing a co-generation facility.
Asia Pulp said the project was still subject to negotiation of definitive joint venture contracts and financing arrangements and other final Chinese government approvals.
